impacts.reason: The impact describes backing/surplus reads and settlement reverting when a registered slot is unreadable; the preconditions establish the Accountant, fresh registration, and inactive slot, and the intents explicitly require verifying readability/activation before registration so reads can dereference registered slots.

The impact concerns totalBackingSigned/distributableSurplus/settleDailyPnL reverting until cleanup; the same preconditions and explicit intents about only registering readable/active slots directly apply.
Yield settlement blocked by failed distributableSurplus is directly addressed by the intents requiring registered slots to be readable/active and registration only after successful reads.

Unavailable backing/surplus accounting while a stale slot remains registered is directly addressed by the explicit intents that registered slots must be activated/readable and registration must wait for successful reads.
